title: Conjoined Twins Lupita & Carmen Andrade Try To Maintain Their Distance After Carmen Gets Married - NewsBreak
text:
By Baila Eve Zisman ,
58 minutes ago Conjoined twins Carmen Andrade and Lupita Andrade are managing to live separate lives and respect one another’s boundaries.
Lupita and Carmen, 25 and born in Mexico, are attached at the torso, sharing ribs, parts of their circulatory, digestive, and reproductive systems – the sisters each have their own heart, stomach and lungs. When doctors told them that a separation surgery could end in death or serious neurological problems, Andrade and Lupita decided to stay as they were. They live in Connecticut.
>50 ‘BEST’ CELEBRITY MUGSHOTS SLIDESHOW
In October 2024, Carmen married Daniel McCormack after the two met in 2020 on Hinge.
In conversation with People , Carmen reflected on how she and Lupita share a body but not a life; “Constantly talking…I don’t know how else to put it.” Andrade went on to explain that she and McCormack are very careful to make sure Lupita is comfortable with whatever is happening, from intimacy to conversation.
“I have headphones and a phone. I don’t care,” Lupita added.
Carmen also specified that she and McCormack are careful to take Lupita into account when planning time together or conversing. She speculated, “I think there’s a certain societal expectation that there needs to be affection the entire time within a relationship. All we do is joke around a lot of the time.”
Carmen also noted that she finds it extremely disrespectful when people ask questions about the twins’ sex lives.
“I don’t understand why people need to know about my private partners in order to humanize us,” she remarked.
McCormack added to Andrade’s point, “People are obsessed with sex, you know? And it’s just like, frankly, it’s none of your f—ing business.”
Lupita also stated her own annoyance with such questions, saying, “I don’t like being asked if I am ever going to love [Daniel]… I love him as a brother. That’s about it.”
“I just want to see my sister happy… I don’t think people understand he would not be around whatsoever if we didn’t get along.”
Asked what made Carmen know McCormack was the one, and what made Lupita encourage her, Lupita remembered, “He asked about our dog.” Carmen agreed, “Honestly, it was the fact that he asked about my dog, more than anything.”
